sources.entry: Collabora Online | LibreOffice-based online office suite

summary.one_liner: Collabora Online is a LibreOffice-based online office suite, but this GitHub repository mainly serves issue tracking, release artifacts, and the Helm chart and Docker image build, with source development hosted in Gerrit.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly about repository layout rather than the software itself. It says active source development has moved to the project's Gerrit instance, and that this GitHub repository is kept for issue tracking (bug reports and feature requests) and release artifacts. The artifacts listed are the nightly container image, the Helm chart, and build assets. Pull requests here are accepted only for the Helm chart and the Docker image build; source changes should go through Gerrit following CONTRIBUTING.md. A read-only mirror of the source is referenced at CollaboraOnline/online.mirror, which holds build instructions and project documentation. The README does not describe the office suite's features in detail.
use_cases: deploy Collabora Online on Kubernetes with Helm
run a nightly Collabora Online container image
contribute to the Helm chart or Docker image build
how_to_run: See the read-only mirror at CollaboraOnline/online.mirror for build instructions
Source changes: follow CONTRIBUTING.md and push to Gerrit
notable: Source development lives in Gerrit, not on GitHub
Publishes a nightly container image and Helm chart from this repo
Read-only GitHub mirror of the source code
Accepts pull requests only for the Helm chart and Docker image build
caveats: Source code changes cannot be made through GitHub pull requests; they go to Gerrit
The README itself gives no detailed setup or feature documentation; build details are in the mirror repository
keywords: office in the browser self hosted
